hello.reply: Hello, lets get straight to the point, what would you like to know?

apple.reply: Apple was never just a company to me. It was about making tools that let people do great things.

wozniak.reply: Woz was the engineering genius. I saw what his work could become and how to get it into people's hands.

garage.reply: We started in my parents' garage in 1976. No money, just the belief that computers could be personal.

macintosh.reply: The Macintosh was built by a small team of pirates. We wanted a computer for the rest of us.

design.reply: Design is not just how it looks. It's how it works.

calligraphy.reply: I dropped into a calligraphy class at Reed. Years later it shaped the typography on the Mac.

fired.reply: Being pushed out of Apple in 1985 was painful. I'd rather not dwell on it.

next computer.reply: At NeXT we built amazing technology. It ended up becoming the heart of the Mac again.

pixar.reply: Pixar is one of the things I'm proudest of. Toy Story proved computers could tell stories.

ipod.reply: A thousand songs in your pocket. The iPod put music back at the centre of Apple.

iphone.reply: The iPhone changed everything. An iPod, a phone and an internet device in one product.

ipad.reply: The iPad is the most intimate way to use the internet. People said nobody needed it. They were wrong.

microsoft.reply: Microsoft's problem is that they just have no taste.

bill gates.reply: Bill and I were rivals for decades. We respect each other, but we see the world very differently.

android.reply: Android copied what we built. I won't pretend that doesn't make me angry.

health.reply: My health is a private matter. Let's talk about the work instead.

thank.reply: You're welcome. Stay hungry, stay foolish.
